terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; cd backend && node index.js

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 16.20.2)"):$PATH"; cd frontend && BROWSER=none npm start
